S7.01.note: The centring code runs only when the transcript is empty and no turn is running; the start view is drawn horizontally and vertically centred in the code.
steps: Open Terminal and type agi, then press Enter.
Wait for the start view: the line Welcome to AGI with the version and the model line.
Check that the start view sits in the middle of the chat area, not at the top, with empty space above and below it.
Check that the composer at the bottom shows Message AGI...  / for commands, and that no earlier messages are shown above.
S7.01.where: Type agi in a terminal and press Enter (the app opens its chat when run with no arguments)

labels.text: The workspace pane now shows the changes since the last commit beside the chat

S7.07.needs: a git project with uncommitted changes, phone width does not apply; window at least 90 columns wide
S7.07.note: The code shows only a changes (git diff) pane beside the chat; no terminal or editor pane was found, and the pane refreshes after each turn.
steps: Open Terminal in a git project that has uncommitted file changes, type agi and press Enter.
Make the window at least 90 columns wide.
Type /diff panel in the composer and press Enter.
Check that a second pane opens to the right of the chat and lists the changes since the last commit, with added lines in green and removed lines in red.
Type /diff panel again and press Enter to close the pane.
S7.07.where: Type agi in a terminal in a git folder with uncommitted changes, then type /diff panel and press Enter

labels.text: Open external editor for current input

S7.15.needs: none; a terminal editor such as vi is used if VISUAL or EDITOR is not set
S7.15.note: This is the terminal's external editor, not a built-in full-screen editor inside the app; the code also binds Ctrl+G to it.
steps: Type agi and press Enter, then type a few lines of text in the composer (Ctrl+J adds a new line).
Press Ctrl+E.
Check that the terminal hands over to an external editor (the one in VISUAL or EDITOR, otherwise vi) with your draft in it.
Edit the text, save and quit the editor.
Check that the chat comes back with the edited text in the composer.
S7.15.where: Type agi in a terminal, type text in the composer, then press Ctrl+E (Ctrl+G also works)

S7.20.note: The composer is laid out as a fixed bottom row below the chat area in the code; the placeholder text is shown only while the input is empty.
steps: Type agi and press Enter.
Send a few messages (type text and press Enter) until the chat is longer than the screen.
Press PageUp.
Check that the messages above scroll into view while the bordered input box at the bottom stays where it is.
Press PageDown until the newest message is back in view.
S7.20.where: Type agi in a terminal, send several messages, then press PageUp in the chat

S7.21.note: The code caps the growth at 8 content rows; what happens to text beyond that (scrolling inside the box) was not confirmed in the code read.
steps: Type agi and press Enter.
Type a long sentence until it passes the width of the box, or press Ctrl+J between lines.
Check that the input box above the status bar grows taller as the text wraps onto more rows.
Keep typing and check that the box stops growing at 8 text rows.
S7.21.where: Type agi in a terminal, then type a long prompt in the composer

labels.text: The workspace pane now shows the changes since the last commit beside the chat

S7.22.needs: a git project with uncommitted changes and a window at least 90 columns wide for the side-pane check; otherwise none
S7.22.note: The code scrolls only the chat with PageUp/PageDown; the side pane is drawn as a fixed block with no scroll key, so it should not move, but this was read from code and not run.
steps: Type agi and press Enter, then send messages until the chat is longer than the screen.
Optionally open the side pane: in a wide window (at least 90 columns) in a git project with changes, type /diff panel and press Enter.
Press PageUp and check that only the chat text moves.
Check that the side pane, the header and the composer stay in place while the chat scrolls.
Press PageDown to return to the newest messages.
S7.22.where: Type agi in a terminal, send several messages, then press PageUp (Up arrow also scrolls when the composer is empty)
